reading: Following a catastrophic earthquake, rescuers are engaged in a desperate scramble for survivors across affected regions of Colombia.
The seismic event has tragically claimed 180 lives, with the death toll potentially increasing as recovery operations continue.
Throughout Tuesday, a series of powerful aftershocks compounded the challenge, further jeopardizing ongoing rescue missions.
Emergency teams are meticulously sifting through immense piles of rubble, hoping to locate individuals still entombed beneath collapsed structures.
The dire prospects for those trapped diminish significantly with each passing hour, intensifying the urgency of sustained efforts.
Specialist urban search and rescue units, alongside local volunteers, have mobilized extensively across the hardest-hit areas.
The precarious stability of damaged buildings presents a constant threat to personnel working tirelessly on site.
Authorities are appealing for international aid and specialized equipment to assist in the complex recovery and relief mission.
Despite the immense challenges, the collective resolve to locate and extract any remaining survivors remains steadfast.
This unfolding tragedy underscores the imperative for robust disaster preparedness and rapid response mechanisms in earthquake-prone nations.

vocabulary.definition: Buried or trapped within something, often implying being sealed off and unable to escape.
Extremely serious or urgent outlooks; a grim or terrible future possibility.
Emphasizes, highlights, or draws particular attention to a fact, idea, or situation.
Involving or causing sudden, extensive, or disastrous damage or suffering.
an action or requirement treated as urgently necessary
unstable or vulnerable to becoming much worse
together with or in addition to another measure
people employed by an organisation or serving in its forces
maintained continuously over a period of time
developing or becoming apparent over time

entries.ja: 何かの中に埋められたり閉じ込められたりして、封鎖されて逃げられない状態であることをしばしば示唆する。
entries.ko: 어떤 것 안에 묻히거나 갇혀, 종종 봉쇄되어 탈출할 수 없는 상태임을 암시하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 被埋葬或困在某物之中，通常暗示被密封且无法逃脱。
entries.es: Enterrado o atrapado dentro de algo, lo que a menudo implica estar sellado e incapaz de escapar.
entries.pt-BR: Enterrado ou preso dentro de algo, geralmente implicando que está selado e incapaz de escapar.

entries.ja: 非常に深刻または緊急な見通し。厳しく恐ろしい将来の可能性。
entries.ko: 극히 심각하거나 긴급한 전망; 암울하거나 끔찍한 미래의 가능성.
entries.zh-Hans: 极其严重或紧急的前景；一种严峻或可怕的未来可能性。
entries.es: Perspectivas extremadamente serias o urgentes; una posibilidad futura sombría o terrible.
entries.pt-BR: Perspectivas extremamente sérias ou urgentes; uma possibilidade futura sombria ou terrível.

entries.ja: 事実、考え、状況を強調し、際立たせ、あるいは特に注目させる。
entries.ko: 어떤 사실, 생각 또는 상황을 강조하거나, 부각시키거나, 특별한 주의를 기울이게 하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 强调、突出或特别提请注意某一事实、观点或情况。
entries.es: Enfatiza, resalta o llama una atención particular a un hecho, idea o situación.
entries.pt-BR: Enfatiza, destaca ou chama uma atenção particular para um fato, ideia ou situação.

entries.ja: 突然で広範囲にわたる、あるいは悲惨な損害や苦痛を伴うか、引き起こすこと。
entries.ko: 갑작스럽고 광범위하며 재앙적인 손상이나 고통을 포함하거나 유발하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 涉及或导致突然、广泛或灾难性的损害或苦难。
entries.es: Que implica o causa daños o sufrimientos repentinos, extensos o desastrosos.
entries.pt-BR: Que envolve ou causa danos ou sofrimentos repentinos, extensos ou desastrosos.

entries.ja: 緊急に必要とみなされる行動や要件。
entries.ko: 긴급하게 필요한 것으로 여겨지는 행동이나 요구 사항.
entries.zh-Hans: 被视为紧急必要的行动或要求。
entries.es: Una acción o requisito tratado como urgentemente necesario.
entries.pt-BR: Uma ação ou requisito considerado urgentemente necessário.

entries.ja: 不安定である、またははるかに悪化する危険がある。
entries.ko: 불안정하거나 훨씬 더 나빠질 위험이 있는.
entries.zh-Hans: 不稳定或容易变得更糟。
entries.es: Inestable o vulnerable a empeorar mucho.
entries.pt-BR: Instável ou vulnerável a piorar muito.

entries.ja: 他の手段と一緒である、またはそれに加えて。
entries.ko: 다른 조치와 함께 또는 그것에 더하여.
entries.zh-Hans: 与另一项措施同时或作为其补充。
entries.es: Junto con o además de otra medida.
entries.pt-BR: Juntamente com ou adicional a outra medida.

entries.ja: 組織に雇用されている、またはその軍隊に勤務している人々。
entries.ko: 조직에 고용되어 있거나 그 군대에 복무하는 사람들.
entries.zh-Hans: 受雇于某个组织或在其部队中服务的人员。
entries.es: Personas empleadas por una organización o que sirven en sus fuerzas.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas empregadas por uma organização ou que servem em suas forças.

entries.ja: 一定期間継続して維持される。
entries.zh-Hans: 在一段时间内持续保持的。
entries.es: Mantenido continuamente durante un período de tiempo.
entries.pt-BR: Mantido continuamente por um período de tempo.

entries.ja: 時間が経つにつれて発展していく、または明らかになっていく。
entries.zh-Hans: 随着时间推移而发展或变得明朗的。
entries.es: Que se desarrolla o se hace evidente con el tiempo.
entries.pt-BR: Que se desenvolve ou se torna aparente com o tempo.
